name: Neon sign
summary: A shared neon sign on a night brick wall: the title glows in big tubes and each friend bends one line under it with a few words, a tube colour and a little doodle; new lines flicker on and anyone can flip the switch.
useWhen: make 412 pine a neon sign everyone adds a line to
something creative the whole chat can make together
a sign for our door with everyone's motto
group art thing for the apartment chat
let everyone write one line about the house
dontUseWhen: house rules people need to agree on (use host-board or signup-board)
a flyer for an event (use flyer-wall)

title.description: The big top line, up to 14 characters, e.g. '412 PINE'

lines.description: Lines already hung, one per friend, up to six: a few words (22 characters at most), a tube colour 0 to 5 (pink, yellow, blue, green, purple, orange) and a doodle 0 to 5 (none, heart, star, arrow, moon, cactus)
